content_zh:
送叶心夏回到姑姑家，陪她们吃了一个晚饭之后，莫凡刚打算继续练习一下雷系魔法，可是，当自己按照平常的方式去练习把控的时候，却立刻感觉到头疼欲裂，那种感觉就好像是在网吧连续打了三个通宵的英雄联盟，整个人都要挂掉了！
尼玛什么情况？？？
精神虚弱的赶脚。
难道是因为今天我使用了两次雷印，雷系魔能的过度消耗导致我精神极度疲乏？
有没搞错，算上公交车那次不完全释放的话，我今天也不过是也只使用了两次雷印，蓝TM就空了？
本以为自己花了有五个月的冥修，使得自己的星尘内的魔能已经足够庞大了，谁知道仅仅释放两次雷印，整个雷系星尘感觉都黯淡下去了。
雷系星尘往常在精神世界里都是比较绚丽多姿的，那紫色的光辉在七颗星子的呼应下宛如一幅唯美的星空画卷，可这会，整个星尘都失去了光泽，陷入到了一片晦暗之中。
一开始莫凡吓了一跳，好在随着自己放松下来休息，雷系星尘有慢慢恢复光辉的迹象，尽管非常缓慢！
“看来，星尘还不够璀璨，每施展一次魔法，星尘的光辉就会黯淡，完全黯淡下去就表示着星尘内的能量消耗干净了。”
星尘库存着魔法之能。
难怪班主任薛木生一天到晚都在强调：哪怕在枯燥也要保持冥修，一个天资再高的魔法师若不勤奋冥修，也会变得无比平庸。
这句话基本上可以理解为：你技能再叼又怎么样，没蓝还是个渣渣！
算了，不想这些东西，赶紧睡上一觉，不然真要挂了！
窝在房间里，一觉睡到大天亮。
叶心夏这姑娘也是乖巧，都快中午了也没舍得叫自己起床。
莫凡从床铺上爬了起来，整个人精神抖索。
娴熟的进入冥修状态，查看了一下自己的星尘，发现星尘已经明亮了大半，想必很快就能够完全恢复往常的光辉了。
“对了，我的雷系恐怕不太好暴露在外人面前，虽然这是‘法’治社会，保不齐会遭人嫉妒，比如说在博城能够只手遮天的穆氏世家。看来我还是得把火系给修炼起来，这样比较容易掩人耳目。”莫凡一边刷着牙一边思考这个问题。
只是，一天自己的精力就那么多，怎么才可以即让雷系正房吃饱，又把火系妃子弄得服服帖帖的呢？
莫凡能够在五个月时间把雷系技能给修出来，正是因为他把所有的修炼时间都放在了雷系身上，甭管火系小妖精有多迷人、魅力四射，莫凡都是专情专一。

每年的魔法考核大概也还有半年时间，自己不想这么早暴露雷系力量的话，就得全神贯注的在下学期全部修火系，把火系技能初阶技能也修炼出来。
可这样做，就意味着自己的雷系星尘的成长要停滞半年了。
不去冥修，星尘不会凭白无故变的更加强壮的！
莫凡对自己接下去的冥修时间进行了一些小规划。
介于每年一次的考核大概还有六个多月的时间，莫凡打算在接下去每天所能够承受的10个小时冥修时间进行一下分配，8个小时修火系，2个小时来温养雷系。
这样，雷系或许会增长的很缓慢，但也可以一定程度上保持把控的熟练度。
每天8小时用来学火系，这对那些一共只能够冥修5小时的其他学生来说，已经得天独厚。
吃中午饭那会，小姑莫青下班回来了。
小姑莫青是一个平凡得不能再平凡的妇女了，身很瘦，面很黄，人很好。
“莫凡过来了啊，我听你爸说你在天澜魔法高中潜心修炼，这次可要好好努力哦，要是能够成为一位初阶魔法师，对我们莫家来说就是光宗耀祖咯！”莫青说道。
初阶魔法师就光宗耀祖了？？
自己这祖祖辈辈是穷了多少代了啊！
唉，也不知道自己现在算不算是了！
“姑丈呢，怎么没见到他人？”莫凡问了一句。
“他送物资到山里给那些猎人，我真搞不明白，他就一个普通人，哪来的那份胆子到山里去，要遇到一只妖魔，那不得把他给生吞了啊！”莫青抱怨道。
“妖魔不是在离我们都市比较远的原始山林里吗？”莫凡说道。
和自己熟知的世界不同，在魔法世界的城市之外栖息着很多多人类有着生命威胁的妖魔，别说是普通人不敢轻易涉足那些地方，就连魔法师在那里都经常丧命。

content_en:
After sending Ye Xinxia back to his aunt's house and having dinner with them, Mo Fan just planned to continue practicing thunder magic. However, when he practiced control in the usual way, he immediately felt a splitting headache. It felt like playing League of Legends for three consecutive nights in an Internet cafe, and he was about to die!
What's going on, Nima? ? ?
Mentally weak and rushing.
Is it because I used Thunder Seal twice today and the excessive consumption of thunder magic energy caused me to be extremely mentally exhausted?
Is there any mistake? Counting the incomplete release on the bus, I only used Thunder Seal twice today, so the blue TM was empty?
I thought that after five months of meditative cultivation, the magic energy in my star dust was already huge enough. Who knew that after only releasing the thunder seal twice, the entire thunder system star dust felt dim.
Thunder stardust is usually more colorful in the spiritual world. The purple brilliance echoed by the seven stars is like a beautiful picture of the starry sky. But this time, the entire stardust has lost its luster and fell into darkness.
Mo Fan was shocked at first, but fortunately as he relaxed and rested, the thunder star dust showed signs of slowly returning to its glory, albeit very slowly!
"It seems that the stardust is not bright enough. Every time the magic is cast, the stardust's brilliance will dim. If it dims completely, it means that the energy in the stardust has been completely consumed."
Stardust holds magical power.
No wonder Xue Musheng, the head teacher, emphasizes all day long: You must keep meditating even when you are bored. No matter how talented a magician is, if he does not meditate diligently, he will become extremely mediocre.
This sentence can basically be understood as: No matter how good your skills are, you are still a scumbag if you don’t have blue!
Forget it, don't think about these things, get some sleep quickly, otherwise you will really die!
Nestled in the room and slept until dawn.
Ye Xinxia is also a well-behaved girl. It's almost noon and she doesn't want to wake herself up.
Mo Fan climbed up from the bed, feeling very energetic.
After skillfully entering the meditative state, I checked my stardust and found that most of the stardust had become brighter. I think it would be able to fully return to its usual glory soon.
"By the way, I'm afraid it's not easy for my thunder element to be exposed to outsiders. Although this is a society governed by the law, if it is not protected, people will be jealous. For example, in Bo City, the Mu family can cover the sky with one hand. It seems that I still have to practice the fire element. This will make it easier to hide from others." Mo Fan brushed his teeth while thinking about this problem.
However, I only have so much energy in one day, how can I keep the thunder-type main wife well fed and the fire-type concubine submissive at the same time?
Mo Fan was able to master the thunder skill in five months precisely because he spent all his training time on the thunder skill. No matter how charming and charming the fire goblin was, Mo Fan was dedicated and single-minded.
The annual magic assessment is about half a year away. If I don't want to expose the power of the thunder system so early, I have to concentrate on practicing the fire system in the next semester and master the basic skills of the fire system.
But doing so would mean that the growth of his Thunder System Stardust would be stagnant for half a year.
If you don't meditate, Stardust won't become stronger for nothing!
Mo Fan made some small plans for his next meditation time.
Since there are still more than six months left for the annual assessment, Mo Fan plans to allocate the 10 hours of meditation time he can afford every day, 8 hours to cultivate the fire element, and 2 hours to warm up the thunder element.
In this way, the thunder system may grow very slowly, but it can also maintain control proficiency to a certain extent.
Eight hours a day are spent learning the fire element, which is a unique advantage for other students who can only meditate for five hours in total.
During lunch, my sister-in-law Mo Qing came back from get off work.My sister-in-law Mo Qing is an extremely ordinary woman. She is very thin, has a yellow face, and is very nice.
"Mo Fan is here. I heard from your dad that you are practicing hard at Tianlan Magic High School. You have to work hard this time. If you can become a junior magician, it will be a glorious ancestor for our Mo family!" Mo Qing said.
Is the junior magician so proud of his ancestors? ?
My ancestors have been poor for many generations!
Alas, I don’t know if I am the one now!
"Where's my uncle? Why haven't I seen anyone else?" Mo Fan asked.
"He delivers supplies to the hunters in the mountains. I really don't understand. He is just an ordinary person. How can he have the courage to go into the mountains? If he encounters a monster, he must be eaten alive!" Mo Qing complained.
"Isn't the demon in the primitive mountain forest far away from our city?" Mo Fan said.
Different from the world he is familiar with, there are many monsters that threaten human life outside the cities of the magic world. Not to mention that ordinary people dare not easily set foot in those places, and even magicians often lose their lives there.
